records.summary: 2026-27 catalog: coursework from institutions with listed institutional accreditors is evaluated; transfer grades are not included in the UT GPA and transfer grades cannot be replaced. Admissions states credit is granted only for college-level non-remedial courses with a grade of D- or better (CDS 2025-26 D12 also reports D-); many programs require C or higher. Remedial, occupational, technical, non-credit and applied-science career courses do not transfer. AA/AS/AFA/AST holders (Fall 2025 entry onward) and certified UT/TBR/Tennessee public general-education completers satisfy the Volunteer Core. Bachelor's degree: 120 hours minimum, 30 upper-division hours, at least 15 of the final 30 hours in residence (other institutions' courses cannot count toward those 15), and 25 percent of required hours at UT Knoxville. Minimum transfer GPA for admission review: 2.0 in transferable academic coursework.

residency_rules.text: Complete at least 15 of the final 30 credit hours in residence at UT Knoxville.
Complete 25 percent of the credit hours required for the bachelor's degree at UT Knoxville (SACSCOC).
CDS 2025-26 D16: minimum 30 hours completed at UT to earn a bachelor's degree.
